interface.title: MATERIA Workbench (v0.5.0-dev.0, public beta)
interface.field: Crystallography and diffraction: neutron and X-ray powder Rietveld refinement, magnetic structure determination, and pair distribution function (PDF) analysis
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis: refining a structure model against reduced diffraction data, judging fit quality and uncertainty, and exporting for checking in GSAS-II, FullProf or PDFgui
interface.what_it_is_for: Refine nuclear and magnetic crystal-structure models against powder diffraction patterns or PDF G(r) data in the browser, with live observed/calculated/difference plots, symmetry tools, least-squares esds and Bayesian posteriors.

data.note: Used the two bundled demos: the Mn3Ga + MnO POWGEN neutron TOF pattern at 600 K, and the GaTa4Se8 X-ray PDF G(r) at 299 K. There were no test files to upload, so the 'own data' route (Load CIF, data, instrument, Open project) was not tried. Downloads made: mn3ga.cif, Mn3Ga_report.html, Mn3Ga_gsas2.zip, Mn3Ga-Rietveld-powder.materia.json and GaTa4Se8_pdfgui.zip.

tree.general: Refine a crystal-structure model against diffraction data and report refined values with trustworthy uncertainties
tree.specific: Refine Mn3Ga/MnO by Rietveld and GaTa4Se8 by PDF in MATERIA, test for magnetic order, check fit quality and posteriors, and export to GSAS-II, FullProf and PDFgui

children.general: Reciprocal-space track: refine a powder pattern, judge the fit and test for magnetic order
children.specific: Rietveld track on the Mn3Ga + MnO POWGEN TOF demo, with validation, posterior and magnetic analysis

children.general: Reciprocal-space refinement of a two-phase powder pattern
children.specific: Rietveld refinement of the Mn3Ga + MnO POWGEN TOF demo

children.general: Open a worked example and look at the observed, calculated and difference curves
children.specific: Load the Mn3Ga neutron TOF demo and inspect the fit (wR 4.01%, GoF 3.05), with Bragg ticks for both phases

children.label: clicked the 'Mn3Ga neutron TOF' demo card

children.general: Inspect the pattern in different units and zoom in on single peaks
children.specific: Switch the x-axis between TOF and d, Ctrl+scroll to zoom, hover for the obs/calc/diff readout, and click a tick to get its hkl

children.general: Choose which parameters to vary, run a least-squares fit, and read the convergence log and correlation warnings
children.specific: Expand the Lattice group, free Positions, press Refine, and read the refined values, esds and wt% phase fractions; then open RESULT: converged in 2 cycles, with a high-correlation warning for bkg0/bkg1

children.general: Restrict the data range used in the fit
children.specific: Drag the blue fit-range handle (wR recomputes live; 6.92% where the explorer stopped, 7.91% in the replay), then press Reset range. In the replay, Reset set the window to the full data range (wR 4.59%), not back to the demo's original 9349–113673 window (wR 4.01%)

children.label: pressed Reset range (full data range, wR 4.59%)

children.general: Look at the refined structure in 3D
children.specific: Open the 3D Model tab, turn on bond lengths and atom labels, rotate, and switch phase from Mn3Ga to MnO

children.label: ticked Atom labels and Bond lengths, dragged to rotate

children.general: Judge fit quality and uncertainty
children.specific: Use the Validation and Posterior tabs on the refined Rietveld model

children.general: Get a diagnosis of what limits the fit
children.specific: Validation tab: acceptance bar (GoF, physical sanity, cross-check), 'What limits the fit' list, plus the residual and cumulative χ² evidence

children.general: Find the worst-fitting peaks and jump to them in the plot
children.specific: Expand Worst peaks and press 'view →' on (3 -1 1); the pattern zooms to that reflection

children.general: Sample a Bayesian posterior and compare its widths with the least-squares errors
children.specific: Posterior tab: Sample posterior (ensemble MCMC, 400 steps) gives a table of marginals, medians, 68% intervals, esd ratio, R̂ and ESS. It reported 'not converged', so Continue was pressed

children.general: Test for magnetic order in the sample
children.specific: Magnetic symmetry analysis on refined Mn3Ga, steps 1–5

children.general: Find a propagation vector from unexplained peaks
children.specific: Tick residual peaks #12, #15 and #17, then press 'Search k from 3 peaks' and pick a k candidate. Alternatively, type k = (0 0 0) and press Set k

children.label: typed k = 0 0 0 and pressed Set k

children.general: List the symmetry-allowed magnetic models
children.specific: Choose a framework. Magnetic space groups lists 102 classes with BNS/OG labels, grouped by index. Representation analysis gives the Γmag decomposition and each irrep's isotropy subgroup

children.general: Preview a candidate model on the data and the 3D cell
children.specific: Click P6₃'/m'mc' (BNS 194.269). Moment arrows appear in the 3D view, and magnetic calc and ticks appear in the pattern

children.general: Refine the ordered moment
children.specific: Step 5: Refine moments for the Γ1 isotropy group. Mn1 Mz refines to 0.00 μB at wR 4.0%, as expected for a paramagnet (the replay got wR 4.6% because its earlier range reset had raised the baseline)

children.general: Fit the nuclear and magnetic models together
children.specific: Continue in refinement page: a MAGNETIC group (1/1 free) is added. Refine gives Mn1 M(Mz) = 0.00197 ± 12 μB, with the result 'stalled · 1 cycle'. The replay, run on the full data range, instead converged in 5 cycles with M(Mz) = -0.00785 ± 2.9 μB and wR 3.86%

children.general: Real-space track: refine a local-structure (PDF) dataset
children.specific: GaTa4Se8 X-ray G(r) demo

children.general: Refine the average structure against G(r) and compare the cell to the reference
children.specific: Load the PDF demo (Rw 8.12%), free ADPs and Positions, and Refine. Rw drops to 7.86% and a = 10.36851 ± 0.00017 Å, against 10.3631 Å in the CIF

children.label: clicked GaTa4Se8 X-ray G(r) demo card

children.general: Break the calculated curve into contributions from each atom pair
children.specific: Tick 'partials' to overlay the Ga–Ga, Ga–Se, Ga–Ta, Se–Se, Se–Ta and Ta–Ta partial G(r)

children.general: Test a lower-symmetry distorted model
children.specific: Subgroups tab: Activate Γ3 → I -4 m 2 (#119). Parameterization switches to Irreps (modes) with separate a and c. Refine converges to a = 10.3753(14), c = 10.3545(29) Å (shown as ±0.0014 / ±0.0029)

children.general: Check whether refined parameters change with length scale
children.specific: Boxcar tab: run a 5 Å box / 1 Å step scan from low to high r, switch the tracked parameter to a (Å), and click a box (r = 8 Å: a = 10.3828 ± 0.0038, Rw 5.14%)

children.label: clicked box at r = 8 Å on the plot

children.general: Keep track of steps and hand results to other tools
children.specific: History, Export and Save/Close in the header

children.general: Step back to an earlier state without losing later work
children.specific: Open History and click 'Refine'. The nuclear-only state comes back and 'Refine nuclear + magnetic' is kept as another branch

children.general: Export refined results for publication or cross-checking, and save the session
children.specific: Export ▸ CIF (cell and positions with esds), Report (HTML) and GSAS-II bundle (.zip). On PDF: Export ▸ PDFgui / diffpy-CMI bundle. Close shows an unsaved-changes dialog; Save downloads Mn3Ga-Rietveld-powder.materia.json and returns to the demo picker

features.name: Observed/calculated/difference profile plot with reflection ticks and fit-range handles
features.general: Overlay measured and modelled curves with a residual strip below. Switch the x-axis units, zoom, hover for values, click a marker for its label, and drag handles to set the range the fit uses
features.specific: Powder pattern panel: TOF/d/Q toggle, Ctrl+scroll or ± zoom, hover readout of obs/calc/diff/bkg, click a Bragg tick for hkl, and drag the blue handles to set the fit window (wR updates live). Reset range sets the full data range, not the demo's original window
steps: Ctrl+scroll to zoom into a region
click a reflection tick to read its hkl
drag a blue handle to change the fit range, then Reset range
serves_tasks: Open a worked example and look at the observed, calculated and difference curves
Inspect the pattern in different units and zoom in on single peaks
Restrict the data range used in the fit

features.name: Grouped parameter table with free/fixed toggles and esd column
features.general: Collapsible groups of model parameters, each with an 'all' checkbox and per-row free/fixed pills. Run a fit, then read the values and uncertainties, a convergence log and correlation warnings
features.specific: Powder/PDF parameters panel: groups (Scale, Background, Lattice, Instrument/profile, ADPs, Positions, Occupancy, Microstructure, Magnetic) with the 'N of M free' counter, Refine/Cancel, ESD column, and a RESULT section with cycle χ²/wR and high-correlation warnings
steps: tick 'all' or click one row's free/fixed pill
open RESULT for cycles and correlations
serves_tasks: Choose which parameters to vary, run a least-squares fit, and read the convergence log and correlation warnings
Refine the average structure against G(r) and compare the cell to the reference

features.name: Fit-diagnosis report with links back to the plot
features.general: A diagnosis panel ranks what limits the fit, gives pass/fail checks and evidence plots, and lists the worst points. Each listed item can send you to that spot in the main plot
features.specific: Validation tab: acceptance bar (GoF, physical sanity, cross-check with GSAS-II/FullProf bundles), 'What limits the fit' with suggested actions, and evidence sections (Residual Δ/σ + cumulative χ², χ² by d-shell, Worst peaks with 'view →', Agreement)
steps: read the acceptance bar and the 'What limits the fit' items
press 'view →' to jump to the reflection in the pattern
serves_tasks: Get a diagnosis of what limits the fit
Find the worst-fitting peaks and jump to them in the plot

features.name: MCMC posterior sampler with convergence table
features.general: Start from the best-fit values and sample the posterior. Show per-parameter histograms, medians, credible intervals, and the ratio of posterior width to least-squares error, with R̂/ESS convergence checks and a button to extend the chain
features.specific: Posterior tab: Sample posterior (ensemble MCMC, 400 steps) gives Marginal, Median, 68% interval, ESD ratio, R̂ and ESS, plus a 'Not converged — continue the chain' banner and a Continue ↻ button
steps: read the marginals and esd ratios
press Continue if R̂ is high
serves_tasks: Sample a Bayesian posterior and compare its widths with the least-squares errors

features.name: Propagation-vector search from selected residual peaks
features.general: Detect unexplained peaks, let the user pick which to use, search for the lattice vectors that index them, and choose one candidate (or type one in)
features.specific: Magnetic step 2: Detected residual peaks table (I/σ threshold, 'include peaks at nuclear positions'), 'use' checkboxes, Search k from N peaks, and a candidate k table (matched/explains/RMSD) with radio selection or manual k + Set k
steps: pick a candidate k (or type k and press Set k)
serves_tasks: Find a propagation vector from unexplained peaks

features.name: Magnetic subgroup / irrep enumerator with live moment preview
features.general: List every symmetry-allowed model for the chosen vector, either as subgroups or as irreducible representations. Clicking one previews it on both the 3D structure and the calculated curve
features.specific: Magnetic steps 3–4: Magnetic space groups (BNS/OG labels, grouped by index, moment dof, 'Rank N candidates against the data') or Representation analysis (Γmag decomposition, irrep checkboxes → isotropy subgroup). The 3D moment preview and the magnetic calc in the pattern update on click. Ranking stalled at 0/14 in this run
steps: click a subgroup or tick an irrep
check the 3D moment arrows and magnetic ticks
serves_tasks: List the symmetry-allowed magnetic models
Preview a candidate model on the data and the 3D cell

features.name: Moment refinement and hand-off to the joint fit
features.general: Refine the few amplitudes the chosen symmetry allows, overlay the result on the main fit, then send the model into the full refinement as a new parameter group
features.specific: Magnetic step 5: moment field (μB), Refine moments (gives wR), Show on refinement pattern, Continue in refinement page → (adds a MAGNETIC group and magnetic ticks to the Rietveld view)
serves_tasks: Refine the ordered moment
Fit the nuclear and magnetic models together

features.name: Branching undo history
features.general: Every model change is logged as a named, time-stamped step with its fit quality. Clicking an earlier step restores it and keeps the later work as a separate branch
features.specific: History dropdown: steps (demo load, Freed p0_pos_Mn1_0, Refine, Magnetic model added, Refine nuclear + magnetic) with wR and time, rename ✎, undo/redo buttons, ⌘Z/⇧⌘Z, and '1 other branch'
steps: read the step list with wR
serves_tasks: Step back to an earlier state without losing later work

features.name: Unit-cell 3D viewer
features.general: Rotatable 3D view of the structure with toggles for labels and bond lengths, a phase switch and an atomic/magnetic cell switch
features.specific: 3D Model tab / Magnetic 3D panel: Phase Mn3Ga|MnO, Bond lengths, Atom labels, drag to rotate, Atomic|Magnetic cell. Axes, Perspective, View a/b/c, Light slider, Finish and CIF/mCIF download are shown but were not tried
serves_tasks: Look at the refined structure in 3D
Preview a candidate model on the data and the 3D cell

features.name: Group–subgroup distortion-mode tree
features.general: List the lower-symmetry versions of a structure, grouped by the symmetry-breaking mode. Activating one adds its distortion amplitudes as refinable parameters, and the change can be cleared
features.specific: Subgroups tab: Potential Γ modes (Γ3/Γ4/Γ5, Activate → subgroup), Decentring modes, Subgroup lattice by index, optional parent CIF. Activation switches the parameterization to Irreps (modes) and shows the 'lowered to Γ3 → I -4 m 2' banner with × clear
steps: refine the freed mode amplitudes and split cell
serves_tasks: Test a lower-symmetry distorted model

features.name: Sliding-window (boxcar) parameter scan
features.general: Refit the same model in a window slid across the data and plot each parameter (with error bars and fit quality) against window position. Pick a window to read it or adopt its values
features.specific: Boxcar tab: box width and step, direction (low→high r, high→low r, both), random restarts, Run boxcar scan/Cancel, parameter chips (PDF scale, a, c, mode), a track plot with an Rw strip, and a box readout with Adopt
steps: click a box to read it (Adopt to load its values)
serves_tasks: Check whether refined parameters change with length scale

features.name: Partial pair-correlation overlay
features.general: Split a modelled total curve into the contributions of each element pair, overlaid on the data
features.specific: 'partials' checkbox on the PDF pattern adds Ga–Ga, Ga–Se, Ga–Ta, Se–Se, Se–Ta and Ta–Ta partial G(r) curves
steps: read each pair's curve against obs/calc
serves_tasks: Break the calculated curve into contributions from each atom pair

features.name: Export menu with cross-check bundles and project save
features.general: Write the refined model and fit out as a structure file, a readable report, input bundles for independent refinement programs, and a project file that keeps the session
features.specific: Export menu: CIF (cell and positions with esds), Report (HTML), GSAS-II bundle (.zip), FullProf bundle and CSV on powder; PDFgui / diffpy-CMI bundle on PDF. Close → 'Close this project?' dialog with Save/Discard/Cancel; Save writes a .materia.json project
steps: pick CIF or Report for publication
pick the GSAS-II or PDFgui bundle to cross-check elsewhere
press Close and Save to keep the project file
serves_tasks: Export refined results for publication or cross-checking, and save the session
